project("lifted-eval")

add_executable(lifted-eval 
    "main.cpp"
    "suite.cpp"
    "suite.hpp"
    "utils.cpp"
    "utils.hpp"
)

target_link_libraries(lifted-eval PRIVATE lifted)

# Suite CSVs are generated by the evaluation targets; paths come from
# EvalHelpers.cmake via cache variables set in each suite's CMakeLists.txt.
target_compile_definitions(lifted-eval PRIVATE
    "EVAL_SYNTHETIC_LIBS_DIR=\"${EVAL_SYNTHETIC_LIBS_DIR}\""
    "EVAL_SUITE_SYNTHETIC_CSV=\"${EVAL_SUITE_SYNTHETIC_CSV}\""
    "EVAL_SUITE_TUM_EVAL_CSV=\"${EVAL_SUITE_TUM_EVAL_CSV}\""
)

# Must be built after the suite targets so .so files + CSVs exist.
if(TARGET eval-suite-synthetic)
    add_dependencies(lifted-eval eval-suite-synthetic)
endif()
if(TARGET eval-suite-tum-small-programs)
    add_dependencies(lifted-eval eval-suite-tum-small-programs)
endif()
if(TARGET eval-suite-tum-basic-algorithms)
    add_dependencies(lifted-eval eval-suite-tum-basic-algorithms)
endif()
if(TARGET eval-suite-tum-simple-hash-functions)
    add_dependencies(lifted-eval eval-suite-tum-simple-hash-functions)
endif()
